note: Analysis of the existing frozen 39-image OCR benchmark. Read-only - no OCR re-run, no benchmark file modified.

confirmatory_vs_exploratory.confirmatory_preregistered_test: Pearson correlation (r, p) - decision gate criterion set BEFORE running the analysis
confirmatory_vs_exploratory.confirmatory_result: NOT significant (r=-0.2267, p=0.1652) - decision: do NOT wire up OCR-confidence flagging

exploratory_only_not_used_for_decision.note_spearman: Rank-based, more robust to CER outlier skew than Pearson - significant (p=0.0311), but NOT used as the go/no-go criterion since it was not the pre-registered test. Reported for transparency and future work only.
exploratory_only_not_used_for_decision.note_mannwhitney: Just misses p<0.05 (p=0.0674) - suggestive but not confirmatory.
exploratory_only_not_used_for_decision.threshold_trend: Monotonic in the expected direction across all 5 thresholds tested, largest gap at threshold=0.7 (CER 0.43 above vs 0.72 below), but n=8 above that threshold - too few samples to treat as confirmatory.

confirmatory_vs_exploratory.limitations: n=39 is a small sample for correlation testing; CER is outlier-skewed (values >1.0 occur on over-extraction), which violates Pearson assumptions and reduces its statistical power. Revisit with a larger OCR benchmark before treating this as settled either way.
confirmatory_vs_exploratory.decision_final: Confidence-aware OCR flagging NOT wired into the live pipeline. Pre-registered criterion honored; no post-hoc test-shopping.
